title: Tiny Subject, Big World
prompt: Make a photograph in which most of the frame is empty or visually quiet. Your subject should be small but still attract our attention.
notice: A lone person, bicycle, bird, or object
Simple areas of light or shadow
questions: Can you simplify the frame by moving?
How does the empty space make the photograph feel?
Would a blurry or detailed background help?

variation.text: Try creating two different moods with the same subject: one calm and one lonely or mysterious.

review_prompt: Which photograph uses the empty space most intentionally?
